moves.name: Decorate
moves.description:
Fairy (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 4
The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
No additional effect.

moves.name: Encore
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

moves.name: Mystical Fire
moves.description:
Fire (Special)
Base Power: 75
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

moves.name: Alluring Voice
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 80
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 5
The power of the target's attack this turn is multiplied by 1.5 (this effect is stackable). Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user or if the ally already moved this turn, but does not fail if the ally is using a two-turn move.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description:
Normal (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

moves.name: Draining Kiss
moves.description:
Fairy (Special)
Base Power: 50
Accuracy: 100
Priority: 0
The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3x normal, rounded half down.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.description:
Psychic (Status)
Base Power: N/A
Accuracy: N/A
Priority: 0
For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5x damage from special attacks, or 0.66x damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

items.name: Leftovers
items.description: At the end of every turn, holder restores 1/16 of its max HP.

items.name: Focus Sash
items.description: If holder's HP is full, will survive an attack that would KO it with 1 HP. Single use.

items.name: Babiri Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Steel-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Sitrus Berry
items.description: Restores 1/4 max HP when at 1/2 max HP or less. Single use.

items.name: Mental Herb
items.description: Cures holder of Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, Torment. Single use.

items.name: Choice Scarf
items.description: Holder's Speed is 1.5x, but it can only select the first move it executes.

items.name: Kebia Berry
items.description: Halves damage taken from a supereffective Poison-type attack. Single use.

items.name: Bright Powder
items.description: The accuracy of attacks against the holder is 0.9x.

items.name: Quick Claw
items.description: Each turn, holder has a 20% chance to move first in its priority bracket.

abilities.name: Aroma Veil
abilities.description: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

abilities.name: Sweet Veil
abilities.description: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokemon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.
